headline: SOVIET SHUTTLE RISES ON UNMANNED FLIGHT
dispatch: Baikonur, Nov. 16. The Soviet reusable orbiter Buran has completed an uncrewed flight from the Baikonur cosmodrome, circling Earth twice before an automatic landing at Yubileyniy airfield. The craft was carried aloft by the Energia rocket and is the first Soviet shuttle-type vehicle to reach space.
